name: BirdLens
description: Real-time bird identification for Even Realities G2. Listens through the mic, sends audio to BirdNET, and shows detected species on the HUD.
author: Pietro Lungarini

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends short microphone clips to the BirdLens analysis backend to identify bird songs.

permissions.name: microphone
permissions.desc: Captures ambient sound to identify nearby bird species.

tagline: Hear a bird? Know it instantly.
